en.title: Global Accessibility Awareness Day 2026: Key Highlights
en.summary: On May 21, 2026, Global Accessibility Awareness Day featured a marathon across Canada, APNA's upcoming disability lives publication, and worldwide calls for inclusive design and digital experiences.
